visual_goal: Show a slice of the destination graph around Lisbon: solid official containment edges, dashed curated edges, an alias that points to one place, and the airport as a point that serves an area.
prompt: A top-to-bottom graph of rounded place nodes on a faint map-texture background. At the top a node 'Portugal'. One solid arrow down into 'Lisbon Metro Area'. From 'Lisbon Metro Area' two solid arrows down into 'Lisbon' and 'Cascais', side by side. From 'Lisbon' one solid arrow down into a small node 'Alfama'. To the left of 'Lisbon', a small tag-shaped node 'Lisboa' with one dashed arrow into 'Lisbon', labeled 'alias of'. At the upper right, a small airplane pin drawn as a point, labeled 'Lisbon airport', with one dashed arrow into 'Lisbon Metro Area', labeled 'serves'. At the lower right, a wavy-coast node 'Lisbon Coast' with two dashed arrows, one into 'Cascais' and one into 'Lisbon', each labeled 'part of'. Solid arrows are dark blue; dashed arrows are orange.
alt: A destination graph: Portugal contains the Lisbon Metro Area, which contains Lisbon and Cascais; Lisbon contains Alfama; Lisboa is an alias of Lisbon; Lisbon airport serves the metro area; Lisbon Coast is part of both Cascais and Lisbon.

visual_goal: Show the geographic layer: the destination graph feeds both query-time place resolution and write-time geo enrichment, enrichment writes cells and public points into the search index and jurisdictions to tax and regulation, and stays search returns list and pins.
prompt: A left-to-right architecture illustration in two rows. In the middle at the left sits a network-of-dots node 'Destination graph'. Top row, query time: a search bar 'Guest query' with one arrow into a box 'Place resolver'; 'Destination graph' also sends one arrow up into 'Place resolver'. From 'Place resolver' one arrow right, labeled 'search area', into a box 'Stays search'. From 'Stays search' one arrow down into a cylinder 'Search index' and one arrow right into a screen showing a list and map pins, labeled 'List and pins'. Bottom row, write time: a filing cabinet 'Place registry' with one arrow into a gear box 'Geo enrichment'; 'Destination graph' also sends one arrow down into 'Geo enrichment'. From 'Geo enrichment' one arrow up-right into 'Search index', labeled 'cells, public point', and one arrow right into a box with a scale-of-justice icon labeled 'Tax and regulation', labeled 'jurisdiction'.
alt: The destination graph feeds the place resolver at query time and geo enrichment at write time; enrichment writes cells and public points to the search index and jurisdictions to tax and regulation, and stays search returns list and pins.

visual_goal: Show one viewport query as a swimlane: the date-free tile cache supplies candidates and public points, availability and price are computed per request, and the pin ranker selects which pins appear with total prices.
prompt: A left-to-right swimlane sequence diagram with five vertical lanes, each headed by a simple generic icon and a label: 'Guest app', 'Viewport API', 'Tile cache', 'Availability and price', 'Pin ranker'. The 'Tile cache' lane is tinted pale blue; the 'Availability and price' lane is tinted pale orange. Horizontal arrows, top to bottom in this order: from 'Guest app' to 'Viewport API', labeled 'viewport, dates, party'; a small loop arrow on 'Viewport API', labeled 'snap to tiles'; from 'Viewport API' to 'Tile cache', labeled 'candidates per tile'; a dashed return arrow from 'Tile cache' to 'Viewport API', labeled 'public points'; from 'Viewport API' to 'Availability and price', labeled 'exact stay'; a dashed return arrow from 'Availability and price' to 'Viewport API', labeled 'total prices'; from 'Viewport API' to 'Pin ranker', labeled 'choose pins'; a dashed return arrow from 'Pin ranker' to 'Viewport API', labeled 'selected pins'; and a final dashed arrow from 'Viewport API' back to 'Guest app', labeled 'pins with totals'.
alt: A swimlane of one viewport query: the viewport API snaps to tiles, gets candidates and public points from the tile cache, checks the exact stay and total prices per request, asks the pin ranker to choose pins, and returns pins with totals to the guest app.
